scope: Independent mathematical review of OCH1-OCH14 and exact endpoint OCH30; full selected implication checked with complementary OCH15-OCH30 independent coverage.

findings.topic: All original finite Artin coefficient algebras
findings.detail: Read OCH1-OCH14 in full and OCH30 against the exact original OneChar contract. Positive finite local cohomology and its reflection/lifting properties follow from the fundamental period sequence under the stated original hypotheses. Unramified diagonal deformations come from weight-zero finite cohomology, including finite-quotient invariants for disconnected actions. The positive-weight central obstruction vanishes. The triangular and arbitrary crystalline lifting arguments retain all finite Artin algebras and exact reduction maps.

findings.topic: Actual ordinary ideal and crystalline component
findings.detail: The canonical labelled inertia flag is stable under the decomposition group. The saturation identity uses Artin-Rees, annihilator killing and distinct projectors, with the original eigenvalue differences. Twisting by 1+t in B[t]/t^(2kh+1) handles Delta=0 and all nonreduced Artin targets. This proves the actual prime component and its twelve-variable chart, with weight multiplicities (1,2,3,4,2), and the original conjugation stability.

findings.topic: Same global deformation datum and graded model
findings.detail: The universal ring uses the original Dat, ULoc, marked g1 and eight normalization equations. The exact Euler/duality calculation gives the printed generator/equation counts. The integral weighted presentation is obtained from actual entry coordinates and a homogeneous kernel in the injective characteristic-zero chart; it does not divide by torus eigenvalue differences. OCH11 supplies the structural model, and OCH12-OCH14 supply its points, derivations and integral lifting fields.

The finite algebra is (A/(Q))_0, not the ambient degree-zero ring. A valuative torus rescaling makes every required point strict-local and proves convergence of the full homogeneous series. Strict-local algebra maps are automatically bounded: if |f(u)|>1, ell*u^m contradicts maximal-ideal strictness for large m. Finite generators then give adic continuity. The dual-number and weight-minus-one derivation construction uses the original ambient ring before relations and finite Taylor division; no unproved continuity of a second component is assumed.

Compared source OneChar including arbitrary original algebraic closures, K, ell, c, N, e, psi, GD, fixed iota, sigma and the exact scalar t. OCH30 descends to an unramified coefficient ring with the same values, applies one shared marked automorphy datum there, and transports the length and trace result back. It retains Adm3 at N or Adm2 at N*abs(discr K), finite Vlen, an actual finite set of representations, RepIso-irredundancy, and the exact factor two. InpZ and AutomorphyUnramifiedCoefficients are the only two theorem-level premises; the latter remains a separate open producer.

findings.topic: Complementary independent coverage and closure scope
findings.detail: The global_estimates independent report covers OCH15-OCH30, including the full model upper bound, actual Selmer injection, irreducible finite trace sum and coefficient descent. This root report covers OCH1-OCH14 plus the exact original selected closure contract. Together they cover all thirty claims. Closing TASK_ONE_CHAR_PROOF does not assert AutomorphyUnramifiedCoefficients, any unrestricted automorphy theorem, or a completed human RH/GRH proof.

selected_whole_contract_reviewed.conclusion: The full original implication InpZ -> AutomorphyUnramifiedCoefficients -> OneChar, with the exact finite trace/length bound on all original data. AutomorphyUnramifiedCoefficients remains independently open.
